liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **ween2010-05-20.nickyc.schoepsmk4.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 34 songs; 158 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **Ween2010-05-20**: source not stated; 34 songs; 158 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the recording good quality work [4]
- **ween2010-05-20.denon**: source not stated; 34 songs; 152 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer found both band and audience subdued and unenthusiastic, with the long break possibly a mistake [4]
- Attendee says the crowd was wild, and band and audience fed off each other's energy [5]
- Attendee says the energy built toward an encore they rank among the best ever [5]
- Taper had a clamp space at the show and met other tapers there [1]
- Reviewer says the show falls far short of the Atlanta show [4]
- Attendee rejects the view that the show was weak, calling the setlist near perfect [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2010-05-20.nickyc.schoepsmk4.flac16**: taped by Nicky C; transferred by Nicky C; source: Schoeps MK4's>Nbox>Oade Mod Edirol R-44 [1]
- **Ween2010-05-20**: taped by Mike Salvo; transferred by Mike Salvo; source: AKE se300b/ck91>Edirol UA-5 (bm2p+)>iRiver H120 [2]
- **ween2010-05-20.denon**: taped by Cousinit; transferred by Cousinit; source: Denon DTR-80P>2 Nak 300's w/CP4 Shotguns [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by T-Bone: [WEEN Concert Poster - RARE - Starland Ballroom 2010 - T-Bone & Aljax - Hamburger | #1900874682](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/ween-concert-poster-starland-ballroom-1900874682) [9]
